result.keywords: Interpretable machine learning is increasingly used to analyze high-dimensional biomedical data. This fictional article surveys pattern discovery methods for omics and neuroimaging signals, combining clustering, classification, embedding, and network-based approaches with statistical validation and permutation-style significance testing. It discusses applications to biomarker prioritization, patient stratification, brain connectivity analysis, and feature selection under small-sample regimes.
